title: Catalog page
evidence: the listing alone on about 3 in 5 catalog pages

steps.note: `catalog-editorial-left` for left-aligned themes, `catalog-overlay-3col` for strong category photography with the darkening on.
Bestsellers under the tiles: the catalog then shows products, not only a way to them. The home hero's button leads to a collection page, not to /catalog.

notes: `source: categories`, a dedicated cover per category (cabinet data), captions under the image; the tile ratio follows the theme (`collectionSnippet.aspectRatio`).
A one-category store may show a product shelf of that category instead, since a catalog of one tile looks empty (an optional idea from one store of the sample).
